explanation: The value is 0 everywhere except at D2 when the agent chose a1 and commonly reached S1. There it is about 10 if the previous trial was unrewarded in the first ~10 trials of the episode (about 2-7 later in the episode, often 0 after trial 70), and after rewarded trials it fades: about 5, then 3, 2, 1 over consecutive rewarded S1 trials, then 0.
